title: The Vatican archives head knows about the hidden material; letters asking access for President Carter
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of The Vatican archives head knows about the hidden material; letters asking access for President Carter, about Carter era at Vatican archives, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: No, he knows because because I sent the letters to them from Jesuit headquarters to ask for access for President Carter.
